image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate covered in pink coralline algae and dark encrusting organisms. The chiton displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal shell plates with distinct ridges and mottled orange, brown, and cream coloration, surrounded by a leathery girdle with spotted patterns.
